messages:
sylvia: Quick heads-up — nightly kbench sweep flagged regression for candidate 'kernswap-v2' on h100 when KV is active. p99 token latency up ~12% vs baseline for long sequences. attaching microbench snippet. :slightly_frowning_face:

omar: Ugh. Can you paste the exact run command and the mini-output? will try to repro locally.

sylvia: repro command I used:
```
./tools/kbench --kernel kernswap-v2 --arch h100 --seqlen 4096 --kv-mode enabled --iters 300 --batch 1
```
output excerpt:
```
seqlen=4096 throughputs: baseline=980 tok/s, candidate=860 tok/s, delta=-12.2%
latency p50/p95/p99 baseline=1.2/3.8/6.5 ms tok, candidate=1.3/4.1/7.3 ms
KV hit-rate baseline=97%, candidate=96% (small drop)
```

lia: interesting that hit-rate drop is tiny but p99 jump is bigger — maybe eviction behavior or a regression in prefetch logic.

mike: Could be cache-coherence at larger sequence windows. Any differences in kernel launch params (grid/block) between baseline and candidate?

sylvia: kernswap-v2 changed the prefetch loop to reduce regs, changed tiling on attention. launch config is computed by autotuner; candidate picks different warp tiling for mid-lanes.

perf-bot: nightly-kbench: run 1743004800 completed. failed-gate: kernswap-v2 (h100, seqlen 4096) — flagged by relative-diff > 5% rule. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/kbench/1743004800/kernswap-v2.tgz :eyes:

omar: I'll pull artifact and run with nvprof/tcu. can someone point to a minimal repro that reproduces the p99 spike (not just throughput)?

sylvia: try this short script that runs a few warmups then profiles p99 latency distribution:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
for i in 1 2 3; do 
  ./tools/kbench --kernel kernswap-v2 --arch h100 --seqlen 4096 --kv-mode enabled --iters 50 --batch 1 --warmup 10
done
# use perf counters: ./tools/collect_nvmetrics --run last --metrics sm__warps_active.avg,sm__cycles_elapsed.avg
```

sam: Also add a microprobe that toggles KV prefetch on/off and exercises longseq evictions. CI currently lacks a focused eviction test. I can prototype one.

adele: Can we mute kernswap-v2 in the nightly gate until we get a triage? It's noisy and blocks other candidates.

taylor: +1 to mute. But let's not drop it entirely — we need to capture why autotuner prefers it for some seq lengths. Maybe it's a seqlen-dependent regression (good at 128/512, bad at 4096).

mike: I ran a quick sweep across seqlens 128/512/1024/2048/4096. Candidate wins at 128/512 (~5-8%) but loses at >=2048. Looks like the autotuner's objective (avg throughput) picked it because low-seqlen workloads dominate the sample set.

lia: So autotuner needs to be seqlen-aware for heavy-tail workloads. We should add weighting or a fallback path that pins long-seq kernels to a different pick.

omar: For immediate triage I'll run with `--kv-mode disabled` to confirm whether KV caching is necessary for the regression. If disabling KV removes the delta, we know it's eviction/prefetch related.

sylvia: quick run results: disabled KV -> candidate vs baseline delta shrinks to -1.8%. So KV interactions amplify the kernel change.

sam: I'll add a targeted microbenchmark `kbench/micro/kv_evict_test.py` that sweeps fill/evict patterns and measures p99. Proposed gating rule: if p99 increases > 6% with KV enabled at seqlen>=2048, fail.

adele: sounds good. Who owns the PR?

sam: I'll open draft PR tonight and tag @eng-runtime. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kbench/pull/489 (draft)

taylor: infra note — CI machine labels must ensure we run these eviction tests on both Ampere and Hopper families. Omar please add `label: h100,hopper` to the nightly matrix.

omar: will do. Also adding a smoothing rule to reduce noise: require regression to appear in 3 consecutive nightly runs before auto-blocking.

sylvia: plan: 1) mute kernswap-v2 for nightly gate, 2) sam adds eviction microbenchmark + PR, 3) omar updates CI matrix + smoothing, 4) we re-run autotuner with weighted seqlen distribution. Anyone object?

adele: no objections. feel free to move to triage board. :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: note: next nightly sweep scheduled 1743091200. Will include draft microprobe if merged by then.

sylvia: thanks all — I'll file a brief postmortem with perf traces and mark owners.
